name: Orbit Bloom: Garden Arcade
subtitle: Swipe, farm & race among stars
promotionalText: Grow a little world among the stars. Swipe botanical circuits, craft TNT, farm roses and apples, and race your harvest home. Your first 10 hints are free.
description:
A little world. Many ways to grow.

Welcome to Orbit Bloom, a connected garden arcade among the stars. Swipe flowers, leaves, apples, dewdrops and diamonds, grow a pocket farm, and race your harvest home.

BLOOM CIRCUITS
Slide neighboring pieces to match three, or tap touching groups. Four in a line creates a Bomb, L and T formations create TNT, a seven-piece cross creates Mega Bomb, and five in a line creates Rainbow. Trigger powers on the board and chain nearby blasts. Clear frost and collect resources across 1,020 stages: twelve authored opening circuits and 1,008 generated expeditions.

FARM AND CRAFT
Plant roses and apples across six plots, water your crops, and harvest coins, compost and cargo. Crops grow while you are away. Craft stronger garden tools and complete permanent field tasks for hints, shuffles and power-ups.

HARVEST RALLY
Swipe your rover through three lanes. Dodge barriers, catch coins, and finish a 22-second delivery. Farm cargo adds a delivery bonus to your shared wallet.

YOUR LITTLE WORLD
Spend earned stars on six garden restoration projects. Enjoy original dimensional botanical artwork, a friendly robot companion, animated coin collections, looping activity music and action sounds. Music, effects and haptics can be adjusted separately.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Start with ten free hints and three shuffles. More can be earned through field tasks or bought with earned game coins. Five normal puzzle lives regenerate one every 30 minutes, including while you are away. Winning returns a life. Farming and racing remain available while you wait.

Optional Apple in-app purchases offer coins, extra lives and a one-time First Bloom bundle. Purchased extra lives do not expire. No account or advertising is required. Progress is stored on your device; deleting the app may delete your saved progress and consumable balances.
reviewNotes:
No login is required. The World screen opens automatically after a short loading screen. Tap Bloom circuits to begin. Swipe neighboring pieces to make three in a row; Hint highlights and describes a valid swipe. Connected groups can also be tapped. On-board powers trigger when tapped and chain nearby powers. Inventory tools appear below the board.

Farm and Race tabs are always available. Plant and water crops; growth is elapsed-time based. Swipe left/right on the race road to steer. World > Field tasks contains permanent reward milestones and formation diagrams.

Each first puzzle win gives 120 coins and one star. Two stars fund each of six ordered restoration projects. Five normal lives refill one every 30 minutes, and a win returns one. Purchased extra lives form a separate reserve.

Shop contains four consumable coin packs, one consumable 5-life pack, and a one-time non-consumable starter bundle. StoreKit verified transactions are credited durably and idempotently. Restore checks non-consumable ownership. There is no advertising, analytics, tracking, account or game backend. Saved progress is device-local.

Build 4 saves collected puzzle water with the resolved board before animation. Reopening during a match keeps the earned water available in Farm without granting it again.
